fields.why: Table 1 sets THC and nicotine product use side by side across four age groups and four race/ethnicity groups, with no test.
Age (4) and race/ethnicity (4) in Table 1; Table 2 sex contrasts within two age strata are pairwise and make no entry.

Flags on entries 0 and 1 are false positives: the chi-square p-values are in Tables 2 and 3 (sex pairs, case vs respondent), not in Table 1. The Table 3 per-group entry counts 3 race levels only because 'Unknown' is one; a rule excluding unknown/missing levels from n_groups would leave 'all other' vs White as pairwise (no entry).

brief_issues: The brief does not say whether an 'Unknown' race level counts toward n_groups (rule 1); here it alone lifts a collapsed non-White vs White comparison to 3 groups.
